title: Florida Orchestra will play a Taylor Swift concert in St. Petersburg - NewsBreak
text:
7 hours ago Taylor Swift performs during the first of her three sold-out Tampa shows on the Eras tour, at Raymond James Stadium, Thursday, April 13, 2023 in Tampa. The Florida Orchestra announced a Taylor Swift-inspired concert, coming to the Mahaffey Theater in St. Petersburg this September. [ MARTHA ASENCIO-RHINE | Times ] Taylor Swift’s music is coming back to Tampa Bay. Are you ready for it?
Steve Hackman’s “Taylor Swift: The Symphony Era” heads to the Mahaffey Theater on Sept. 12, kicking off the 59th season of the Florida Orchestra.
Creator and conductor Hackman is known for blending popular artists with classical music, with past shows combining Brahms with Radiohead, Beethoveen with Beyoncé and Tchaikovsky with Drake. During the Swift show, he will conduct the Florida Orchestra along with four vocalists and a live band.
While Swift herself will not appear at the event, the performance will feature fresh orchestral arrangements of songs spanning her many eras, from recent hits like “The Fate of Ophelia” to early career anthems like “Love Story” and “You Belong with Me.”
“This isn’t a tribute concert,” the orchestra said in an announcement. “It’s a completely original experience that draws unexpected comparisons between songs and unearths new musical Easter eggs, promising to keep even the most dedicated Swifties on their toes.”
The Swift show will be followed by two live orchestral performances of Disney’s “Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl” on Sept. 18 and 19. Viewers will watch the entire film on a big screen as the Florida Orchestra brings the soundtrack from Klaus Badelt and Hans Zimmer to life. Pirate costumes are encouraged, especially on Sept. 19 — International Talk Like a Pirate Day.
Other season highlights include Tchaikovsky’s 1812 Overture on Oct. 2 and 4 at the Mahaffey Theater and the Raymond James Pops series kickoff on Oct. 9 and 10 — Revolution: The Music of The Beatles at the Straz Center and Mahaffey Theater.
If you go Steve Hackman’s “Taylor Swift: The Symphony Era” takes place on at the Mahaffey Theater on Sept. 12. Tickets start at $38, including fees.
Disney’s “Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl” concert takes place on at the Mahaffey Theater on Sept. 18-19. Tickets start at $28, including fees.
Purchase tickets at (727) 892-3337 or visiting FloridaOrchestra.org .
